# Meridian house style guide

## Section 1
Use British spelling. Prefer active voice. Avoid jargon such as 'synergy', 'leverage' and 'circle back'. Numbers under ten are written as words. Dates are written 3 March 2026. Section 1 applies to all client-facing material, internal memos, and slide decks.
